faq.title: Frequently Asked
faq.description: Have questions about how we collaborate, our security practices, or engagement timelines? Find clear answers below or contact our solutions engineering team directly.

items.question: What software engagement models does Nexora Technologies offer?
items.answer: We offer flexible models tailored to your roadmap, including Dedicated Engineering Squads, Time & Materials for agile co-development, and Fixed-Scope Turnkey delivery for well-defined deliverables.

items.question: How do you ensure enterprise-grade security and IP confidentiality?
items.answer: Security and IP protection are fundamental to our practice. All client code, data, and artifacts are 100% your proprietary IP covered by strict mutual NDAs. We adhere to SOC 2, ISO 27001 standards, and zero-trust repository access.

items.question: How quickly can an engineering squad be onboarded and deployed?
items.answer: Following initial architectural alignment and scoping workshops, dedicated squads typically begin sprint kickoff within 1 to 2 weeks.

items.question: Do you provide post-launch maintenance and 24/7 cloud support?
items.answer: Yes, our managed cloud operations provide 24/7/365 infrastructure monitoring, automated alerts, SLA-backed incident response, security patching, and continuous performance tuning.

items.question: Can you modernize our existing legacy monolithic software stack?
items.answer: Absolutely. We specialize in non-disruptive cloud migrations and modular refactoring, breaking down monolithic systems into resilient microservices while maintaining complete business continuity.
